worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure in polymerization reactor R-1
causes: Runaway exothermic polymerization reaction generating excessive vapor
Nitrogen pressure control valve PC failing wide open, exposing the reactor to 100 psig supply
Blockage or closed valve on the vapor outlet path (V-12 or E-1 tube side blockage)
Backflow of pressurized nitrogen from the downstream flare header through a failed flare knock-out drum
consequences: Overpressurization of R-1 beyond its design limit of 50 psig, leading to catastrophic rupture and toxic/flammable monomer release

existing_safeguards.description: Rupture disk installed on the reactor top nozzle, sized for full runaway reaction relief

safeguard_gaps: No pressure relief valve (PSV) or rupture disk on the reactor vessel
No automated high-pressure emergency shutdown system
recommendations: [Process Safety] Install a safety relief valve (PSV) or a rupture disk on R-1 sized for runaway reaction and nitrogen regulator fail-open scenarios.
[Instrumentation & Controls] Install a high-pressure transmitter with an alarm (PAH) and a safety interlock to automatically close the monomer feed valve V-2 and nitrogen valve V-3.

worksheet.deviation_description: High temperature in polymerization reactor R-1
causes: Loss of cooling water flow to the reactor internal coil during active polymerization
Steam valve V-4 failing open or leaking steam into the coil during polymerization
consequences: Acceleration of reaction rate leading to thermal runaway, excessive vaporization, severe pressure buildup, and potential reactor rupture
Simultaneous freezing of the jacket cooling medium due to the same temperature rise, cracking the reactor jacket
safeguard_gaps: No temperature monitoring, alarms, or automated cooling response systems on R-1
recommendations: [Instrumentation & Controls] Install redundant temperature transmitters (TT) on R-1 with high-temperature alarms (TAH) and an automated safety interlock to shut off monomer feed and steam, while opening emergency cooling water.

worksheet.deviation_description: High monomer feed rate to reactor R-1
causes: Upstream pressure spike or manual valve V-2 opened too far by operator error
consequences: Excessive concentration of reactant in R-1, leading to a rapid exothermic polymerization rate that exceeds the cooling capacity of the internal coil, causing thermal runaway

existing_safeguards.description: Flow control loop already regulates monomer feed to a fixed maximum setpoint

safeguard_gaps: No flow control, flow measurement, or automatic feed shut-off valve on the monomer line
recommendations: [Process Engineering] Install a flow control loop (FE/FCV) on the monomer feed line to limit the maximum monomer feed rate, and a high-flow alarm (FAH).

worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure in nitrogen supply line to R-1
causes: Failure of pressure regulator PC in the wide-open position
consequences: 100 psig nitrogen pressure applied directly to R-1 (design pressure 50 psig), leading to mechanical failure of the reactor shell
Reduction of reactor pressure to vacuum conditions, collapsing the vessel inward

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure regulator PC regulates downstream nitrogen pressure

safeguard_gaps: No safety relief valve downstream of PC or on R-1 to handle regulator failure
recommendations: [Process Safety] Install a safety relief valve (PSV) on the reactor R-1, and an upstream overpressure protection system on the nitrogen supply line.

worksheet.deviation_description: Reverse flow of reactor contents into the nitrogen supply system
causes: Reactor pressure exceeding nitrogen supply pressure (100 psig) during runaway reaction, combined with check valve mechanical failure
consequences: Contamination of the facility-wide utility nitrogen network with toxic, flammable, and polymerizing monomer, causing plugging and hazards elsewhere

existing_safeguards.description: Check valve (non-return valve) installed upstream of V-3
existing_safeguards.instrumentation_ref: check valve symbol upstream of V-3

safeguard_gaps: Single check valve is prone to fouling or leakage from polymerizing monomers
recommendations: [Process Safety] Install a double block and bleed system with automatic isolation valves that shut when high pressure is detected in R-1.

worksheet.deviation_description: Complete loss of cooling water flow to reactor internal coil
causes: Utility cooling water system failure, closed manual valve V-6, or physical line blockage
consequences: Loss of heat removal during exothermic polymerization, resulting in rapid temperature and pressure rise inside R-1, leading to thermal runaway
safeguard_gaps: No flow or pressure monitoring on the cooling water inlet stream to detect loss of cooling
recommendations: [Instrumentation & Controls] Install a low-flow alarm (FAL) on the cooling water supply line to provide early warning to operations.

worksheet.deviation_description: Low cooling water flow to condenser E-1
causes: Manual valve V-10 or V-11 throttled too much, or utility supply header pressure drop
consequences: Reduced condensation capacity in E-1, leading to excessive vapor carryover to D-1 and the vacuum system, potential overpressurization of D-1 (design pressure 50 psig) and organic vapor discharge to vacuum pump
safeguard_gaps: No cooling water flow monitoring, high-pressure alarm, or high-temperature alarm on the condenser/separator system
recommendations: [Instrumentation & Controls] Install a cooling water low-flow alarm (FAL) on the E-1 cooling water supply line.

worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid level in separator drum D-1
causes: Failure of level controller LC, pump P-2 mechanical failure, or closed manual valve V-13/V-14
consequences: Liquid carryover into the vacuum system via V-15, leading to vacuum pump damage, potential loss of containment, and environmental release

existing_safeguards.description: Level controller (LC) regulating pump P-2 operation
High-high level trip already interlocked to isolate the vacuum system automatically

safeguard_gaps: No high-level alarm (LAH) or automated high-high level safety trip (LAHH) to isolate the vacuum line
recommendations: [Instrumentation & Controls] Install a high-level alarm (LAH) and a safety interlock to automatically shut down monomer feed and isolate vacuum valve V-15 on high-high level in D-1.

worksheet.deviation_description: No discharge flow from centrifugal pump P-2
causes: Pump motor electrical failure, loss of prime/cavitation due to low level, or closed manual valve V-14
consequences: Inability to transfer liquid out of D-1, causing liquid level to rise, leading to eventual liquid carryover to the vacuum system

existing_safeguards.description: Level controller (LC) on D-1 controls pump operation

safeguard_gaps: No low-flow or pump trip alarms
recommendations: [Operations] Install a local discharge pressure gauge or low-flow indicator, and establish procedures for manual draining or starting a standby pump if P-2 fails.

worksheet.deviation_description: Loss of vacuum / high suction pressure at vacuum pump VP-1
causes: Air ingress through a failed drum seal
Downstream flare header backpressure transmitted through an open bypass valve
consequences: Loss of vacuum in D-1, causing monomer vapor to be drawn back into the reactor headspace and re-condense on cold internals, forming an uncontrolled polymer plug
safeguard_gaps: No suction pressure monitoring or seal integrity alarm on the vacuum pump
recommendations: [Instrumentation & Controls] Install a suction pressure transmitter with alarm on VP-1 and periodic seal integrity checks.

worksheet.deviation_description: Reverse temperature gradient inside R-1 causing bottom-up cooling
causes: Incorrect jacket flow direction after maintenance reversed the inlet/outlet piping
consequences: Localized hot spots at the top of the reactor accelerate fouling and polymer scale formation, reducing heat transfer efficiency over time
safeguard_gaps: No jacket flow direction verification instrumentation
recommendations: [Operations] Verify jacket piping direction against P&ID during every maintenance turnaround.
